description: Image Description: The image shows a modern parking meter located on a sidewalk next to a paved road. The meter is primarily silver and black in color, with a digital display screen at the top that reads "EXPIRED" and indicates "COINS or CREDIT CARD." Below the screen are several colored buttons: blue, red, and green, likely for navigating the interface. A slot for inserting coins is visible below the buttons, labeled "COINS ACCEPTED" with denominations of $1
